verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a tax authority, which could publish power-of-attorney or authorization forms, third-party roles, and signature rules. The evidence pack documents none of this. It covers Webfile and eSystems login, EDI, filing through approved tax-preparation software, and open data. Preparer software and an authenticated eSystems portal are adjacent filing channels, not a published third-party authorization framework.
